title: Okayama Prefecture Tourism — Yumeji Main Museum

facts.fact: The main museum is at2-1-32Hama in Okayama, close to Korakuen; not the Setouchi birthplace.

Artist is associated with Taisho Romantic culture; commercial shop/cat sightings are not guaranteed.
